alex.g: quick flag  noticed a recurring bump in invoice previews for a handful of tenants around hour boundaries. Preview shows ~2x tokens for the 13:00 UTC hour window. Ledger path stays normal.
maya_ops: can you share an example tenant + raw event?
alex.g: tenant=t-77. raw nearline ingestion shows two inserts with slightly different processed_hour: 2026-03-22T13:00:00Z and 2026-03-22T12:59:00Z but both map to the same hour bucket due to truncation logic. Looks like ingest worker clock skew + our "round-down to hour" logic cause one request to appear in both hour buckets in preview aggregation. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-22T12:59:59.842Z ingest-nearline worker=ing-7 event_uuid=e3b9 ts=2026-03-22T12:59:59.842Z processed_hour=2026-03-22T12:00:00Z fp=fpA tokens=1200
2026-03-22T13:00:00.103Z ingest-nearline worker=ing-42 event_uuid=e3b9 ts=2026-03-22T13:00:00.103Z processed_hour=2026-03-22T13:00:00Z fp=fpA tokens=1200
```
alex.g: same event_uuid but two processed_hour values -> preview nearline stores both inserts; dedupe in final ledger uses `event_uuid` so invoice is fine. Preview grouping doesn't use event_uuid currently (fast path uses `fingerprint||tenant||hour`) so duplicates survive.
raj_platform: oof. So this is a nearline race: workers with different clocks write with different truncated-hour keys. Proposed fixes: 1) change nearline aggregation key to include `event_uuid` (preferred), 2) canonicalize processed_hour using CDC watermark (slower), or 3) apply an idempotent upsert by event_uuid during preview aggregation.
sara_billing: option 1 seems safest for correctness but could increase index cardinality. Preview stores are designed for quick cardinals, adding event_uuid will blow up storage. Option 3 (idempotent upsert) seems attractive: keep current key for grouping but ensure we dedupe by event_uuid at write time.
maya_ops: upsert by event_uuid requires a small write path change (nearline supports upserts but we rarely use them). Performance hit unknown. We could gate with a feature flag `preview_upsert_by_event=true` and enable only for tenants in canary set. Also we should add a sampling approximation when upsert is off to avoid overcounting.
leah_support: from support POV we need the console to not freak customers out. Can we add a small note on preview cards: "Estimates may include transient duplicates around hour boundaries" and a toggle to compute an "aligned" preview (recomputed using ledger dedupe rules) for the last 24h?
sara_billing: we can add a preview API param `window_mode=raw|aligned`. `raw`=current fast aggregation, `aligned`=idempotent-aligned view (slower). UI toggle ok. Also add `preview_meta.window_adjusted: true/false` in response.
raj_platform: telemetry wishlist: `preview_window_overlap_rate` (ratio of distinct_event_uuid_count / aggregated_rows), `preview_duplicate_tokens` (tokens attributed to duplicate event_uuids). Alert if duplicate_tokens > 15% of preview_tokens for top-50 tenants.
alex.g: good. For rollout: 1) implement upsert-by-event in nearline but leave disabled by default, 2) add `window_mode` param and preview_meta, 3) implement banner + support toggle, 4) enable upsert for canary tenants and monitor telemetry for 24h, then ramp.
maya_ops: timeline: I'll create rollout ticket and plan canary for 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Sampling strategy: if we need to reduce throughput impact, we will sample shadowed or late events at 10% ingress during initial ramp.
sara_billing: also plan a nightly recompute job that refreshes preview cards for 72h window once upsert is live, so existing misleading previews are corrected. Need to coordinate DB load.
raj_platform: note: upsert might change nearline index compaction characteristics; adding tombstone churn. We'll instrument GC and compaction SLOs. Also `window_mode=aligned` will require a read-path join against the event_uuid index for the 24h window which is heavier. Make it optional and paged.
leah_support: I'll prep support template: how to explain previews vs invoice and how to use "aligned" toggle. Also link to #eng-platform-status for ongoing updates.
billing-bot: [automated] Created ticket BP-4399: "nearline preview upsert + window_mode toggle" assigned to raj_platform, maya_ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/BP-4399
alex.g: owners: raj_platform -> implement upsert + telemetry + compaction alerts, maya_ops -> rollout & sampling orchestration, sara_billing -> preview_api & UI meta + nightly recompute, leah_support -> support comms.
raj_platform: one more thought  instead of storing event_uuid in the grouping key, we can compute a 64-bit hash of event_uuid and only persist the hash field to reduce index width. Should be enough for dedupe semantics and keeps storage slightly better. Thoughts?
sara_billing: ok if we document collision risk (<1e-12) and include event_uuid in debug endpoints for support. Fine by billing.
maya_ops: no objections. I'll schedule the canary and post the plan in #eng-platform-ops.
alex.g: thanks all. Hoping this reduces the preview spikes and makes console numbers less scary. :relieved:
